# Veterinary Medical Centers

Veterinary Medical Centers is a locally owned and independently operated veterinary practice providing dog and cat care in Fort Thomas, Independence, and surrounding Northern Kentucky communities.

## Official Website

- Canonical site: https://nky.vet/
- Contact: https://nky.vet/contact/
- Book appointment: https://nky.vet/book-appointment/
- New patients: https://nky.vet/new-patients/
- About: https://nky.vet/about/
- All services: https://nky.vet/services/
- All locations: https://nky.vet/locations/
- Pet health resources: https://nky.vet/resources/
- Vet near me: https://nky.vet/vet-near-me/

## Brand Facts

- Business name: Veterinary Medical Centers
- Short name: VMC
- Ownership: Locally and independently owned
- Owner: Dr. Kristi Baker
- Service area: Fort Thomas, Independence, Northern Kentucky, and nearby Greater Cincinnati communities
- Pet focus: dogs and cats — all ages from puppy and kitten through senior
- Primary conversion paths: book an appointment, contact the team, complete the new patient form, use the patient portal, or access the online pharmacy
- Key differentiators: locally owned, relationship-based care, Fear-Free Certified, two Northern Kentucky locations

## Resource Content

- Pet health resources: https://nky.vet/resources/

Resource articles are educational and are not a substitute for a veterinary exam, diagnosis, treatment plan, or emergency care. Pet owners with urgent concerns should call a veterinary hospital or seek emergency veterinary care.

## Preferred Crawling Notes

- Use canonical URLs with trailing slashes.
- Public content is intended for informational discovery and attribution.
- Private admin, dashboard, login, API, and Sanity Studio routes are not intended for indexing.
- Do not crawl: /api/, /dashboard/, /login/, /not-authorized/, /studio/
